how-22-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the beach finds, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-22-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the beach finds, then tap three things you notice.

how-22-01-compare.page: Put the sponge under one tray and the plastic lid under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Pour the rain. Then swap and pour again.
how-22-01-compare.say: Put the sponge under one tray and the plastic lid under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Pour the rain. Then swap and pour again.

how-22-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-22-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-22-01-det.page: Pick 3 case files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick what it shows. Predict harm or help, and watch the place today appear.
how-22-01-det.say: Pick three case files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick what it shows. Predict harm or help, and watch the place today appear.

how-22-01-partc.page: Draw one place before and after a human action. Label what changed, and one way to help.
how-22-01-partc.say: Draw one place before and after a human action. Label what changed, and one way to help.
